# Harbor city facade artwork

`harbor-facades-v1.webp` is an optimized project asset generated with the built-in image generation tool. It is mapped onto three-dimensional buildings, not used as a flat scene backdrop.

Generation prompt: Create a square orthographic facade texture with three equal vertical bands: terracotta brick with navy windows and cream stone trim; golden ochre stucco with turquoise shutters and wrought-iron balconies; cobalt glazed modern panels with charcoal frames. Each band has three window columns and four evenly spaced storeys. Rich saturated architectural detail, subtle weathering, flat diffuse daylight, vertically repeatable spacing. No perspective, roof, ground, sky, text, trees or people.

The renderer uses one third of the atlas per building and repeats its four-floor pattern according to the building's height. Loading is non-blocking and retains procedural materials if the asset fails to load.
